about_the_game:
Step into the spotlight, survive the swarm, and become the last star standing. Can you satisfy the bloodthirsty audience and stage a massacre worthy of prime-time ratings?

In the not-so-distant future, humanity has mastered the art of cloning — only to use it for one thing: turning clones into zombies for a blood-soaked TV survival show. Your goal? Survive as long as possible with the help of combat drones, deadly traps, and an insatiable thirst for ratings.

Game Features:

  • Intense Top-Down Action

     Think fast or die faster. Outsmart cloned zombie swarms with brutal traps, tactical movement, and your deadly drone army.

  • Drones of Destruction 

    Unleash a deadly squad of combat drones — from laser-cutters and electro-shockers to bombers and toxin-sprayers — with even more waiting in your arsenal.

    Upgrade, combine, and deploy them for maximum destruction and efficiency.

  • Your Arena - Your Rules 

    Place traps and shape the battlefield to your advantage.

    Each arena is procedurally generated — no two runs are ever the same.

  • Traps & upgrades 

    Crush, burn, impale, and obliterate the undead in wild and creative ways.

    The more chaos you unleash, the higher your ratings soar.

  • Choose Your Zombiminator

    Step into the show as your chosen Zombiminator — each with unique abilities and progression paths.

  • Dark satire & bloody style

    A vicious parody of reality TV where every kill boosts your ratings and every death is part of the show.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7/10/11
  • Processor: i5-4670K @ 3.40GHz or similar
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 970 or better
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Welcome to the bloodiest show of the future! In this explosive rogue-lite arena shooter, you survive endless waves of cloned zombies with the help of deadly combat drones. Deploy traps, upgrade your arsenal, and turn the arena into a brutal spectacle!
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Russian, Japanese
